name: Youth Spirit Artworks job training
what_you_do: You can get arts training and paid jobs if you are a low-income or homeless young person.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 25, low-income or homeless youth (per the Berkeley Public Library jobs page).
pay_detail: Job training rate not posted. The home page lists a $300 stipend for full participation in some workshop series.
deadline_text: Closed as of Nov 2, 2026. The home page FAQ says YSA is not actively accepting applications. No reopen date is posted.
how_to_apply: Call (510) 858-7229 or email community@youthspiritartworks.org (both on the home page) and ask about job training. The Berkeley Public Library jobs page lists jobtraining@youthspiritartworks.org.
notes: As of Nov 2, 2026, the home page says YSA serves youth 14 to 25 at 1740 Alcatraz Ave, Berkeley, with free drop-in hours, workshops and events. Some workshop series pay a $300 stipend if you finish. The home page does not list a job program or its pay, so the 15 to 25 age range, the paid jobs and the job email come from the library page and are not confirmed. The FAQ says YSA is not taking applications right now. Ask before you plan on a job. It is not on the City of Oakland 2026 summer jobs list.
